paper_metadata.title: Uncovering the effect of aging temperature on micro deformation incompatibility and strength-ductility evolution of a novel high-strength titanium alloy with bimodal microstructure

evidence.quote: A novel high-strength titanium alloy Ti-5Al-7.5V-0.5Mo-0.5Zr-0.5Si (TC5751S) was 880 ℃ solution treated and 500 ℃ /550 ℃ /600 ℃ aged to obtain various bimodal microstructures.

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure of TC5751S after heat treatment
evidence.quote: After solution treatment at 880 ◦C, equiaxed primary α phase (αp), transformed β matrix (βt) consists of residual β and a small amount of αs (which precipitated during air cooling), as well as a small number of dispersive silicides, are simultaneously preserved in the current TC5751S alloy

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure of TC5751S after heat treatment
evidence.quote: The average thickness of αs and β lath in 880 – 500 sample is measured to be 142.94 nm and 65.41 nm, respectively (cited from our previous work [19]), while that of 880 – 600 sample is 205.23 nm and 105.78 nm, respectively
